tokens.name: text-header
tokens.usage: Headings, titles, selected labels and ink-coloured icons. 15.0:1 on bg-panel, 13.3:1 on bg-canvas. Ink on the green action fill (7.5:1 on success).

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Running text in panels, menus, sheets and card faces. 10.5:1 on bg-panel, 9.3:1 on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: text-light
tokens.usage: Muted text: meta lines, row labels, counts, grey icons. 5.2:1 on bg-panel, 5.0:1 on bg-panel-hover, 4.65:1 on bg-canvas (the binding ground; do not lighten).

tokens.name: text-on-color
tokens.usage: White text on a saturated fill. Older look only: the lane puts text-header on its green actions.

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: The board ground behind cards. Never a component background.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Every surface that holds content: cards, panels, menus, sheets, tips, toolbars, dialogs.

tokens.name: bg-panel-hover
tokens.usage: Neutral hover and the selected-row fill in menus, tabs and lists. Never blue.

tokens.name: panel-tab-active-bg
tokens.usage: Selected face on the older rails and the lens bar. A cool tint, flagged in the toolbar audit for replacement by bg-panel-hover.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Hairline around panels, menus, tips and cards, and between groups (Tailwind border-panel-border). 1.2:1, so it never marks a control.

tokens.name: border-emphasis
tokens.usage: A stronger quiet edge for dividers that must read on light panels.

tokens.name: border-field
tokens.usage: The only border that marks an editable field or a dashed underline in quoted words. 3.7:1 on bg-panel.

tokens.name: canvas-grid-dot
tokens.usage: The board's dot grid. Same value as border-field, separate meaning.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Olumi blue. Olumi's own voice and marks only: the answering words, Olumi's proposals, Olumi's own mark. 4.8:1 on bg-panel but 4.25:1 on bg-canvas, so never as text on the board.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Olumi blue as text on a blue tint or on bg-canvas (5.6:1 on bg-canvas).

tokens.name: info-light
tokens.usage: Olumi blue tint for Olumi's highlights and proposal halos. Body text on it reads 7.0:1.

tokens.name: info-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on an Olumi control.

tokens.name: info-active
tokens.usage: Press on an Olumi control.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of info. The older look's blue primary chip; never a lane action.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Action green. The one filled button for a person's next step (VIEW_CHIP_PRIMARY_CLASS, Send, Keep). text-header on it reads 7.5:1. Also outcome kind and positive state.

tokens.name: success-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on the green action.

tokens.name: success-active
tokens.usage: Press on the green action.

tokens.name: success-light
tokens.usage: Green tint for confirmed or positive states.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Legacy: the older blue primary turned green on hover. Same value as success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Signal amber for fills, borders and icons only. Not a text colour.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text: 5.4:1 on bg-panel.

tokens.name: warning-light
tokens.usage: Amber tint behind a warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Risk kind and alerts, as fill, border or icon. 2.8:1 on bg-panel, so never as body text.

tokens.name: danger-light
tokens.usage: Risk and alert tint.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a destructive control.

tokens.name: danger-active
tokens.usage: Press on a destructive control.

tokens.name: goal
tokens.usage: Goal (aim) kind: marker fill and card frame. Never an unset link.

tokens.name: goal-light
tokens.usage: Goal tint: the selected session-goal tile.

tokens.name: option
tokens.usage: Option kind: marker fill and card frame.

tokens.name: option-light
tokens.usage: Option tint.

tokens.name: factor
tokens.usage: Factor kind: marker fill and card frame; strong divider.

tokens.name: factor-light
tokens.usage: Factor tint (same value as border-default).

tokens.name: rail-icon
tokens.usage: Older rail glyphs. 4.3:1 on bg-panel.

tokens.name: behaviour-icon
tokens.usage: Older behaviour glyphs.

tokens.name: edge-positive
tokens.usage: A link that raises its target.

tokens.name: edge-negative
tokens.usage: A link that lowers its target. 4.6:1 on bg-panel.

tokens.name: edge-neutral
tokens.usage: A link with no sign yet, input and size roles.

tokens.name: olumi-mark-orange
tokens.usage: The mark's circle. Also the challenged-card frame. Mark only otherwise.

tokens.name: olumi-mark-blue
tokens.usage: The mark's triangle. Mark only.

tokens.name: olumi-mark-green
tokens.usage: The mark's square. Mark only.

tokens.name: text-light-rgb
tokens.usage: Channel triple for the muted text and focus-ring colours.

tokens.name: focus-color
tokens.usage: The global focus ring colour (text-light at 60%). Lane focus rings use text-header; never blue.
